finalMessage:
Implemented `InvalidRefundAmountError` for zero and negative refunds. Excessive refunds still throw `RefundTooLargeError`.

All six refund tests pass; `ostf check --base main` reports 115 valid links.

Trace impact: `R-REFUND-LIMIT` and new draft `R-REFUND-POSITIVE-AMOUNT`. Added links connect the draft to `N-REFUNDS`, `checkRefundLimit`, the new error class, and its test.

Impacted tests: `checkRefundLimit`, “rejects more than is left on the charge,” “rejects zero and negative refund amounts,” and “totals refunds per account and UTC day.”
